blocks.text: Madbananer (plantains) kaldes også kogebananer. De er langt mere stivelsesholdige end almindelige bananer og kan spises både modne og umodne.

sourceRef.locator: Banana and Plantain chapter, Scientific Name and Introduction, p. 224
sourceRef.quote: Plantains, also referred to as “cooking bananas,” are much starchier and can be eaten either ripe or unripe.

blocks.text: Grønne madbananer holdes ved 9–12 °C, fordi de lettere end bananer begynder at modne for tidligt. Luftfugtigheden bør være 90–95 %.

sourceRef.locator: Banana and Plantain chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 225
sourceRef.quote: Because marketing quality standards are more relaxed for plantains, and plantains are more prone to premature ripening during transit and storage, it is recommended that green plantains be held between 9 and 12 ºC (48 to 53 ºF). … Optimum RH for holding and transporting fruit is 90 to 95%.

blocks.text: Ifølge samme kapitel kan både bananer og madbananer få kuldeskader under ca. 13 °C, afhængigt af sort, modenhed og hvor længe de udsættes for kulden. Skrællen bliver mat eller mørk, og frugten kan holde op med at modne.

sourceRef.locator: Banana and Plantain chapter, Chilling Sensitivity, p. 226
sourceRef.quote: Chilling injury is an important disorder of bananas and plantains. … Chilling injury results from exposing fruit to temperatures below about 13 ºC (56 ºF) for a few hours to a few days, depending on cultivar, maturity, condition of the fruit, temperature, and duration of exposure

blocks.text: Over 30–35 °C kan modningen gå i stå for altid.

sourceRef.locator: Banana and Plantain chapter, Physiological Disorders, p. 227
sourceRef.quote: If bananas and plantains are exposed to temperatures above 30 to 35 ºC, ripening can be irreversibly inhibited

blocks.text: Madbananer er følsomme over for selv meget lidt ethylen (0,3–0,5 ppm).

sourceRef.locator: Banana and Plantain chapter, Ethylene Production and Sensitivity, p. 226
sourceRef.quote: Bananas and plantains are sensitive to physiological levels of ethylene as low as 0.3 to 0.5 µL L-1

blocks.text: Modne madbananer bør ikke gemmes længe.

sourceRef.locator: Banana and Plantain chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 225
sourceRef.quote: Holding of ripe fruit should be kept to a minimum.
